Home to William & Mary’s football and track & field programs, venerable Zable Stadium underwent a tremendous transformation with the completion of a $28 million renovation in August 2016. Made possible because of a $10 million gift in from the estate of the late Walter J. McGlothlin ’66, the renovated stadium, which combined with the $11 million Jimmye Laycock Football Center, gives W&M some of the finest football facilities at the FCS level. Walter and Betty Zable, classes of 1937 and 1940 respectively, made a commitment of $10 million to the Campaign for the Fourth Century in the fall of 1990.
